findings.title: Chores task/action content is clipped at desktop and landscape heights

evidence.observation: At 1440x900 square-cell month calendar extends beyond modal viewport; header/close and confirm action are clipped.
At 390x844 month controls, selected date and Reschedule Task action are visible together.
Check Mail text begins at y=374 in a 390px viewport; its center hit-test resolves to the fixed tab bar. Wheel/drag attempts leave the main ScrollView scrollTop at 0.

findings.impact: At 1440x900 the Chores reschedule header/confirm controls are clipped. At 844x390 the first task row is covered by the persistent tab bar and input attempts do not scroll it into the usable viewport, blocking ordinary chore actions.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Correct Chores vertical composition and scroll ownership at short heights so the task list scrolls above the persistent tab bar; independently constrain the month sheet and keep title/close/primary action visible.
closure_evidence: 390x844 and 844x390 task row is visible and hit-testable
wheel and touch/pointer scroll moves Chores content above tabs
task oracle for Check Mail and selected reschedule date

findings.title: Weekly voting cannot be reopened from the seeded results phase

evidence.observation: Results dialog is the ordinary UI state; voting key unavailable.
Same results phase at mobile; canonical voting anchor not captured.

findings.impact: Family cannot start the next weekly vote through an ordinary visible action in audited runtime; voting workflow cannot be verified.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Add an explicit next-cycle transition at the weekly boundary while preserving prior results and schedule.
closure_evidence: no/partial/all vote, schedule, cycle, repeat and stale-state oracles

findings.title: Expired reward remains actionable under Active Rewards

evidence.observation: Sleep In Day is under Active Rewards with Expired label and active Use button.
Expired item opens Use It confirmation.

findings.impact: Household sees contradictory reward status and can attempt to use an expired item.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Remove expired rewards from actionable Active list or disable Use and provide explanation/history.
closure_evidence: assert no expired reward has actionable Use

findings.title: Seeded Market curator names do not match fixture household identities

evidence.observation: Ice Cream context identifies curator-only controls and disables Add Stock for active seeded account.
Disposable QA item QA Restock Fixture with stock 2 exposes Add Stock editor.

findings.impact: Expected manager cannot use some seeded Market actions; QA used a labeled disposable in-memory item. This does not establish production authorization behavior.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Bind seeded curators to deterministic member IDs while preserving non-owner restrictions.

findings.title: Repeated animation and deprecated-style warnings remain

evidence.observation: Reanimated shared-value read during render plus deprecated shadow* and pointerEvents warnings; baseline also reports browser native-driver fallback.

findings.impact: No user-visible jank proven; repeated warnings reduce runtime fault signal.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Remove render-time shared-value reads and replace deprecated web style props after task blockers.

findings.title: Nested settings route and browser animation fallback require closure

evidence.observation: Desktop nested settings route warning and Animated native-driver fallback; no task failure isolated.

findings.impact: Direct link, Back and return-state closure remains incomplete.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Correct only the nested route ownership and web fallback configuration after blocker fixes.

findings.title: Auth screen displays an unproven fixed social-proof count

evidence.observation: Auth screen states “14,203 chores completed today”; source embeds this literal with no displayed provenance or current measurement.
Same fixed claim in mobile sign-in sheet.

findings.impact: New households may interpret a hard-coded claim as a current real platform metric. It creates trust risk at the first entry point.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Remove the number or replace it with a live, sourced, privacy-safe aggregate whose time window and provenance are supportable.
closure_evidence: source-backed metric definition and refresh path, or claim removed
runtime data is not implied by a local fixture

findings.title: Household Settings presents inert Add, Manage and member-row affordances

evidence.observation: Rendered Household Settings shows Manage, Add and right chevrons for each member. Pointer probes on Add, Manage and Sarah Kim left route/body unchanged and opened no dialog; each target was a DIV with no role/aria label. Source app/(app)/settings/household.tsx implements Add/Manage without onPress and member rows as a View.
Same household-management screen at desktop anchor.

findings.impact: Household managers may try to add or edit members from Settings and receive no response. The screen has no keyboard role for the apparent controls.
findings.smallest_bounded_fix: Wire Add and Manage to real supported workflows or render them as non-actionable status; make member rows keyboard-operable only if their chevrons promise navigation.
closure_evidence: pointer and keyboard probes produce same intended action
add/edit/save/cancel and return path for the same fixture member

optional_aesthetic_hypotheses.observation: A 78-character QA chore name is ellipsized in the dense list; full text remains in the DOM and row expands. Similar-prefix collisions were not challenged.
optional_aesthetic_hypotheses.next_probe: Compare two long names with the same first 30 characters; verify search and expanded/edit views distinguish them before considering row-height changes.

blockers.evidence: family-meal-voting missing at both anchors; current results screenshots show all three fixture members voted; no ordinary next-cycle action; store reset method has no visible caller.
family-member-create and family-member-editor both point to editor screenshots in frozen manifest; distinct key-named create PNGs exist, but frozen mapping cannot be corrected.
Retained run and accessible local inputs have no authoritative Golden UI v3 clause IDs or JOIN-01..09 definitions; no numeric mappings are invented.
200 percent browser zoom and short-height open-keyboard/IME remain unverified. Long chore name was captured in a disposable context; list ellipsizes while DOM retains full text.
Rolling capture-progress writer kept valid rows but replaced earlier event arrays; only final voting attempt events survive.
